ranking_rule.primary_objective: maximize sustainable realistic after-cost geometric daily growth below and above the 1% reference while satisfying survival and recoverability
ranking_rule.survival_constraint: a candidate with forced liquidation, irrecoverable account damage, or a prohibited elapsed-time liquidation cannot rank

first_place.selection_reason: The all-breakout route is the highest recorded current-exit-contract-compatible path. Its independently reproduced account grows 0.0900854% per UTC calendar day at 12bp and 0.0700189% at 24bp. It remains provisional because the execution venue is a Binance proxy, funding and exact Bybit BBO/depth are absent, 2024+ is unopened, and winner removal destroys the path.
known_weaknesses: Binance USD-M completed bars are a proxy rather than exact Bybit execution.
Completed 60-minute bars do not reproduce tick-level stop-order triggering.
The median trade is -50bp and only 20.2% of trades win.
The five largest winners provide about 65% of positive PnL.
Removing the largest positive 10% of event keys changes the 12bp return to -26.29% and the 24bp return to -26.95%.
No 2024 or later sequential interval was opened.
This is a non-ML benchmark and cannot satisfy the final system requirement.
Daily growth remains far below the 1% reference.

unranked_results.reason: Removed: maximum_hold_bars=96 defaults surviving positions to an eight-hour timeout open, a prohibited elapsed-time liquidation.
Removed: maximum_holding_minutes precommits a horizon and the executor closes surviving positions at the scheduled maximum time.
Removed: candidate.hold defines timeout_i and surviving positions exit with reason timeout.
Removed: Candidate.maximum_hold_bars is a fixed elapsed-time liquidation.
Removed: durable result status is INVALID and the positive specification contains hold=48.
Removed: the four-trade best raw path uses hold_minutes=30 and becomes negative after winner removal.
Outside the fixed four-symbol traded universe; no normalized BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP-only account path exists.
One sparse sample-day trade is not a normalized full-calendar account growth path; the model was inferior to structural distance and the trade disappears under winner removal.
Source-only probes, hard-invalid outputs and non-tradable oracles have no ranking account path.

component_rankings.reason: The 50%-queue, 3-second-TTL routing gate improved modeled five-second execution drag while remaining unsuitable as a standalone strategy.

reconciliation_notes: Reproduced the Donchian all-breakout account from the registered immutable 2023 snapshot and restored its complete 12/18/24bp metrics.
Removed five lower-ranked legacy paths that use fixed hold bars, maximum holding minutes or timeout exits, plus one INVALID hold-based result.

Inserted current-contract-compatible structural-exit candidates even when their local result record labeled the screen non-rank-eligible; incomplete execution comparisons are disclosed through VERY_LOW confidence rather than suppressed.
Rank does not imply economic-gate passage, deployment permission, research priority or protection.
